newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae Sept 30 Q3 shr rises to $1.79.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae Sept 30 Q3 shr rises to $1.79.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
Full company name is Student Loan Marketing Association
NOTE: 1996 Q3 and nine months core earnings per share were $1.71 and $4.91 respectively.

The company said results for the nine months ended Sept 30 1995 were presented on a pro forma basis assuming the change in method of accouting for student loan income was effectove prior to 1995. This added $1.86 per share to the period, it said.

The company said for the third quarter 1996 growth was mostly the result of an 11 percent growth in managed student loan assets, lower expenses and higher net floor revenues. Results also benefited from the company's share buy back program.
